meta.note: Earth values are sampled from open data. Moon/Mars target values are still placeholders - see backend/pipeline/targets.json.

slope.label: Slope
slope.desc: Mean slope over a ~2 km patch (0 = flat, 1 = 25 degrees or steeper)

roughness.label: Roughness
roughness.desc: Elevation scatter after removing the average tilt (0 = smooth, 1 = 50 m or more)

temp_range.label: Temperature extremes
temp_range.desc: Thermal range (1 = 120 K or more). Earth uses annual air-temperature extremes; Moon/Mars use surface temperature range - a proxy, not an exact match.

aridity.label: Aridity
aridity.desc: 1 = no precipitation. Moon and Mars are set to 1 (no rain).

basaltic.label: Volcanic/basaltic geology
basaltic.desc: Hand-tagged share of basaltic or volcanic terrain (0-1)

meta.assumption: Moon and Mars have no vegetation or rainfall. Aridity is compared as a relative proxy.
data_sources: Moon/Mars targets: see each target's provenance (LOLA, Diviner, MOLA, THEMIS via NASA PDS)

targets.name: Shackleton Crater rim
targets.blurb: Permanently shadowed crater at the lunar south pole, a leading candidate for ice and a base location.

provenance.all: Slope/roughness: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1), 5x5 grid at 500 m on the rim crest. Temperature range: rough team estimate, not sourced. Basaltic: estimate.

targets.name: Malapert Massif
targets.blurb: High, often-illuminated massif near the south pole with Earth line-of-sight, considered for a base.

provenance.all: Slope/roughness: LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1), 5x5 grid at 500 m at the summit area. Temperature range: rough team estimate, not sourced. Basaltic: estimate.

targets.name: Jezero Crater
targets.blurb: Ancient lake basin with a river delta, landing site of Perseverance.

provenance.all: Temperature range: derived from July-Aug 2021 daily curves (about 200-260 K), arXiv:2204.12850. Slope/roughness/basaltic: team estimates, not measured.

targets.name: Gale Crater
targets.blurb: Impact crater with a central mound of layered sediments, explored by Curiosity.

provenance.all: Temperature range: derived from July-Aug 2021 daily curves (about 190-250 K), arXiv:2204.12850. Slope/roughness/basaltic: team estimates, not measured.

candidates.name: Atacama Desert, Chile
